title: Toki Doki
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In this 2016 one-shot by Naoshi Komi (Nisekoi), Hatsu Takagi has 'Kokuhaku disease', a rare illness that limits how many heartbeats she has left, tracked by a device on her chest. After Hato Iijima accidentally walks in on her changing and sees the device, she admits she wants to live fully rather than avoid excitement. Hato vows to help her enjoy life and make her heart race, including through a school band.
life_message: A life lived fully, with music and friends, is worth more than a longer life spent hiding from feeling.

content.note: Accidental walk-in while she changes; light teen romance.
Resignation and isolation due to illness (AniList Disability 100); choosing joy despite risk.
